banner.title: Get reminders on your phone
banner.body: Turn on notifications to hear about it at the right time, even with the app closed.

install.title: Install the app to get notifications
install.body: On iPhone, notifications only work with the app on the home screen.
install.step1: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar.
install.step3: Open the app from the home screen and turn notifications on.
